messages:
Sam (Sales): FYI AcmeCorp just sent a combined SOC2 + GDPR questionnaire. They're specifically asking for 3 things: longer audit log retention, per-tenant retention controls, and exportable attestations. Link: https://acme.example/qna (they asked to prioritize).
Alex (PM): thanks. do we have an intake record? what's the ask deadline?
Sam (Sales): Deadline is next Tue for RFP response. They want an answer on feasibility + rough timeline.
compliance-bot: Automated intake created — ticket #C-7782, uploaded questionnaire pdf.
Maya (SE): quick skim: retention asks include 7y retention for admin access logs, ability to set retention per-customer, and proof of deletion/chain-of-custody. Also a question on KMS/HSM usage.
Lisa (Security): 7y is heavier than our standard 90d default. For SOC2 scope we can provide 1yr of searchable logs and archive rest encrypted in cold storage — but per-tenant UI and legal export will need infra + policy work.
Ravi (Support): a workaround for slow path: offer exportable S3 snapshots of logs on request (manual for now), documented SLA for retrieval. Low-effort but not ideal for product ask.
Alex (PM): propose we bucket this into 3 options for Acme and internal prioritization:
- Option A (Quick): 90d search + 5y cold encrypted archive accessible via paid export (manual retrieval) — 1 sprint + ops runbook.
- Option B (Product-lite): add per-tenant retention UI + automated archive export (self-serve) + KMS integration — 2-3 sprints + infra changes.
- Option C (Enterprise): 7y searchable logs, HSM/KMS guarantee, SLA for e-discovery — dedicated roadmap epic (quarter+), pricing uplift.
Maya (SE): technically Option A needs: archive hook to cold storage, retention flag, basic admin API. estimate ~1.5 engineer-sprints (backend) + 0.5 frontend. Option B adds per-tenant policy model and export UI ~2 more sprints. Option C implies index rework for long-term search — big.
Lisa (Security): for SOC2 evidence we can provide attestation + log integrity checks for Options A/B. HSM request depends on infra integration — escalate if required.
Sam (Sales): Acme will push for Option B but budget may only support Option A. we should present both with tradeoffs.
Alex (PM): next steps: 1) draft response to Acme with Option A (fast) and Option B (recommended). 2) Create product ticket and backlog candidate for Option B with acceptance criteria. 3) Rag-rate risk/cost for legal team. Owners: Sam -> customer comms, Maya -> tech feasibility doc, Lisa -> security feasibility, Alex -> create ticket + prioritize.
Ravi (Support): I'll add a temporary runbook for manual exports and a support template for Acme questions.
Sam (Sales): agreed. Can we get the feasibility doc by EOD tomorrow? they want a one-pager for procurement.
Maya (SE): I'll drop the feasibility one-pager in the ticket by EOD tomorrow — will include minimal config, infra notes, and rough estimates.
Lisa (Security): sending a short note about control gaps and mitigations; will call out encryption-at-rest, KMS options, and audit attestation language.
Alex (PM): I'll create the backlog item now: /create ticket Product-1102 with summary 'Per-tenant retention & enterprise archive (Acme request)' and assign to @Maya. tagging @Legal for contract language.
compliance-bot: Ticket Product-1102 created and linked to intake #C-7782.
Sam (Sales): perfect. i'll draft the customer email once we have the one-pager. :thumbsup:
Alex (PM): priority suggestion: P1 for sales cycle (timeboxed to 2 sprints for Option A deliverables), P2 for Option B evaluation. we'll revisit next sync.
Maya (SE): noted. adding a small checklist for the ticket:
- acceptance criteria: per-tenant retention flag, export API + manual export doc, archived objects encrypted with KMS, sample attestation export.
- tests: e2e export, retention enforcement, key rotation scenario.
- rollout: behind feature flag for dedicated customers.
Ravi (Support): will prepare support templates and a KB article draft.
Lisa (Security): will prepare suggested attestation text and list of controls we can sign off on today.
Sam (Sales): thanks everyone. i'll keep pressure but flexible on scope. please ping if anything blocks the one-pager.
Alex (PM): closing loop — we'll update the ticket and ping Acme after the EOD deliverables.
Maya (SE): signing off for now.
Lisa (Security): ack.
Ravi (Support): ack.
compliance-bot: Intake status updated -> 'product evaluation in progress'.
